  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM geographic_zones) as zones_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plant_geographic_zones) as plant_zones_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plants WHERE conservation_status IS NOT NULL AND conservation_status != '') as plants_with_conservation
